newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary prelim 96 current account deficit estimate $1.7 bln. [CORRECTED 14:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Hungary prelim 96 current account deficit estimate $1.7 bln. [CORRECTED 14:50 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text to read current account deficit instead of foreign trade gap)
The Hungarian government on Friday said that its preliminary estimate for the 1996 current account deficit was $1.7 billion, government spokesman Elemer Kiss said.
The estimate was below the government's earlier prediction of a deficit of about $2 billion.
Kiss said the new estimate was based on figures for the first seven months when the gap was $963 million.
He gave no indication of factors contributing to the lower than expected deficit estimate.
